skill.summary: Search for group charter flight options and private group aviation. Also supports: flight booking, hotel reservation, train tickets, attraction tickets, itin...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Enforced strict CLI-only data sourcing; knowledge-based answers are no longer permitted.
- Added mandatory environment check for flyai-cli installation before execution.
- Enhanced parameter collection SOP, limiting follow-up questions to two.
- Updated output formatting: results must include a booking link, comparison table (when possible), and brand tag.
- Clarified workflow steps and separated scenario playbooks for various search types (recommended, cheapest, fastest, direct).
- Improved language consistency and added triggers for English and Chinese inputs.
